speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit. The table is this one. I have had the gate from Alse, who had it from the lane, and I do not propose to send anyone back to improve the account.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I only said the gate was open when people came past. I did not say I knew the man. I would like to know if he was hurt. That is the whole of my question.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I do not know if he was hurt. I saw the gate standing open, the hasp wrenched, a cap in the road, and backs running north. I did not see them bring him out.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: At the looms they have a name for the trade, and not a name for the man. A silkweaver, like myself. And English. That is what they are sure of. The rest is louder than it is sure.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: English, and a weaver. If that is the sure part, I will keep that part, and I will leave the loud part where I left it this morning.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: So it is not yet us.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Eat what you have cut. A small piece is still a piece, and the house is not fasting because a road was noisy.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: If he is English, and a weaver, why was the gate open at all? I am not asking who to blame. I am asking why a gate.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I cannot tell you why. A man in the road said the talk was the Lord Mayor, and words at his door about the dearth. The man had not been at the door. I will not hand you a cause I do not have.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The dearth I believe, because the bread is smaller before anyone cuts it. The door I do not know. I am not making the door into a story. I am only holding a smaller piece.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And you will not finish it at my table. You are in this house under your own name, at your own work, and you will sleep in your own bed. That is the sentence in this room.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Under my own name. Yes. I am grateful for the sentence. I cut the bread because my hand wanted a smaller thing to hold. Not because you told me to be afraid.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody at this table is going back to the gate. Margery's figure at the house was two hundred, and it is her figure. Cowley had a boy's account, and no count in it. They agree that people ran toward the noise. I would not go down to choose between them.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then the honest number is the one you saw. One gate. One cap. The rest can be large and still be someone else's.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Eat. Alse, the white band is not part of this, and I will not have Sunday's linen dragged in to explain a Friday. The pot is the pot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The band can stay out of it. So can the Master, and so can the play. I played this afternoon. The gate was the morning. They are not the same hour.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will go to the loom in the morning, by the ordinary way. If the way is quiet, I will not invent a noise to bring home. If it is not quiet, I will come home early, and I will tell you, and not the lane.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: That is a good plan, and it is enough plan. William, pass the bread you are not eating. Gillis has made his piece small enough for two consciences.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Take it. I am not hungry for a larger piece than his. I saw backs. I did not see a rescue. I am not going to describe one.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then I will stop asking why. One gate. I can remember one gate without a sermon under it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. One gate is a thing a household can carry. Two hundred is a thing a stair can carry. We are not a stair.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will carry the trade, and the word English, and the smaller bread. I will not carry a number home from a loom that did not count.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the table has our own loaf and nothing of the road but what I have already said. The road keeps the rest.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I can live with a cut loaf. I do not need the story to grow while we eat.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the meal is over. The gate does not come in with the plates.
